title: Old-style knitr chunk options are not supported
message: Quarto Markdown does not support knitr-style chunk options in the header. Move options into the body using `#| key: value` syntax, or use the Pandoc class form `{.r ...}` instead of `{r ...}`.

cases.name: bare-label
cases.description: Bare identifier after the language token (the reporter's case from issue #152).

cases.name: comma-args
cases.description: Canonical knitr form with a comma after the language token.

cases.name: comma-and-kv
cases.description: Comma form with multiple key=value arguments.
